scenes.caption: USDC on Avalanche C-Chain arrives as PUSD · the wait is cut, the clock in the corner is real
scenes.text: Here, USDC on Avalanche comes in. One deposit on that chain lands as BCH at a landing address, and the contract turns it into PUSD. The wait is cut, and the clock in the corner keeps the real time. The receipt links every transaction.
